description: This source file contains extensions and helper methods for the CronJobEditor SwiftUI component, focusing on managing cron job configurations including loading (hydrateFromJob), saving (save), payload building, validation, and various utilities related to cron job scheduling and session target handling.

methods.name: gridLabel
methods.description: Creates a styled label view with a secondary foreground style and fixed width.

methods.name: hydrateFromJob
methods.description: Populates the editor's properties from a given job object, parsing and assigning values to various scheduling, payload, and delivery fields.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Attempts to build the payload from current input, calls onSave handler on success, or sets an error message if validation fails.

methods.name: buildPayload
methods.description: Constructs a dictionary representing the cron job payload with validation, transformation, and optional fields.

methods.name: buildDelivery
methods.description: Builds delivery mode configuration including channel, recipient, and effort options.

methods.name: trimmed
methods.description: Returns a trimmed version of the input string, removing whitespace and newlines.

methods.name: requireName
methods.description: Ensures the job name is non-empty, throws an error if missing.

methods.name: buildSchedule
methods.description: Creates a schedule dictionary based on the user’s selected schedule type and associated inputs.

methods.name: buildSelectedPayload
methods.description: Builds the payload dictionary depending on the payload type and session target.

methods.name: validateSessionTarget
methods.description: Validates the combination of session target and payload type, throws an error if inconsistent.

methods.name: validatePayloadRequiredFields
methods.description: Checks required fields for payloads and throws errors if missing.

methods.name: applyDeleteAfterRun
methods.description: Sets the deleteAfterRun flag in the payload root based on schedule and class properties.

methods.name: buildAgentTurnPayload
methods.description: Constructs a payload for agent turn type with message, thinking, and timeout options.
